Container.Name: FUTONotes
Container.Overview: Self-hosted encrypted sync server for FUTO Notes. Your notes are encrypted on your device before they are uploaded, so this server stores opaque encrypted blobs and never sees their contents. It is single-user: one sync password, one vault, no accounts to manage. New installs need no database server, only a directory on disk. This implementation is wire- and storage-compatible with the previous TypeScript server, so existing clients and existing data keep working.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Mark the session cookie Secure, so browsers send it only over HTTPS. Set it to false only if you reach the server over plain http:// from a browser The mobile apps use a bearer token and are unaffected either way.
